description: Create a new, empty CV (resume) on the user's TakeMeUp account and return its id and editor link, optionally with a template. Free. Use to start a CV from scratch or from a file the user attached, then fill it in with save_takemeup_cv.

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: create_takemeup_cv
title: Create a blank CV
